name: 3D Screen Mirroring
summary:
Give your Mac screen room to grow.
3D Screen Mirroring brings your Mac display into an immersive viewing space on Meta Quest. Settle in front of a large curved virtual screen, enjoy supported stereoscopic 3D content, and surround your screen with colorful ambient effects.
Make the experience yours:
• Adjust screen size and curvature for comfortable viewing.
• Choose screen layouts and fit options.
• Customize ambient styles, glow strength, and shadows.
• Use Quest controllers to adjust settings and recenter
